experiment.title: WebNN detection + honest BitNet-style software model
experiment.medium: WebNN if the UA exposes it; otherwise JS/WASM ternary-weight matmul
experiment.measures: If WebNN is present, run a tiny matmul/conv and label the implementation backend the UA reports (CPU/GPU/NPU). If the UA does not name the 990, do not title the result NPU 990 TOPS. If absent: JS/WASM BitNet-style matmul over a user-chosen context length up to a software 128K token buffer — a teaching model of MediaTek's 128K context claim, not a measurement of their accelerator. Quote MediaTek's relative 2x tokens / 100% faster 3B LLM with URL, never as absolute tokens/s. Computed model: energy per transferred bit vs MAC (generic E=alpha*C*V^2) with symbolic constants, to explain why CIM exists.
experiment.cannot_claim: NPU 990 TOPS, CIM array dimensions, aggregator 100 TOPS, LiteRT MT6990 as a performance score.
